Note that if I use `printerr()` instead of `print()` here (which we technically should do), the message will fail to appear on Windows (tested in Git Bash in the VS Code integrated terminal). This happens both with the main and `console` executable. This is what caused the `--test` error message not to appear, since `ERR_PRINT()` always prints to stderr.

However, it works if I start a cmd session within that Git Bash session.
